innāḥ etāvatkṣaṇān recakādiḥ karttavya iti niyamitā ity arthaḥ / Saṃkhyābhir
iti / Mātrāṇāṃ dvādaśādisaṃkhyābhir ity arthaḥ / Yadapi saṃkhyābhir api kālaniyama eva kriyate,
tathāpi prakārabhedād bheda iti / Yatra hi śaṅkhadhvanyādinā kālaniyamaḥ kriyate sa kālena
paridṛṣṭaḥ, yatra ca vakṣyamāṇamātrāsaṃkhyābhiḥ kālaniyamaḥ kriyate sa saṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭa iti
/ Saṃkhyārthaṃ mātrā ca mārkaṇḍeyaproktā-- nimeṣonmeṣaṇe mātrā kālo laghvakṣaraṃ tathā /
prāṇāyāmasya
saṃkhyārthaṃ
smṛto
dvādaśamātrikaḥ
//
iti
/
nimeṣādilaghvakṣarāntaṃ
mātrāpramāṇam, tad
